Zázračný fond skolila stará chyba  Správne odhadnúť budúcnosť nestačí, ak investor nedokáže prežiť krátkodobý pád. 77226.subject: 💰 The Funding: How the crypto VC space is maturing
77226.body:
Deal count keeps falling, the bar keeps rising, and crypto investing is looking more and more like traditional venture.

The Funding ( https://www.theblock.co/?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Written by Yogita Khatri | Edited by Zack Abrams

Happy Sunday, and welcome to the 57th edition of The Funding!

Over the past several editions, I've covered ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2026-06-28-the-funding-why-crypto-vcs-are-expanding-beyond-crypto-406472?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) various ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2026-04-19-the-funding-why-the-bar-for-crypto-vc-is-higher-than-ever-398015?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) changes ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2025-08-24-the-funding-why-raising-a-crypto-vc-fund-is-harder-now-even-in-a-bull-market-368051?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ) across the crypto venture market ( https://www.theblock.co/newsletters/the-funding/2026-03-22-the-funding-token-to-equity-shift-crypto-394596?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters ). With deal activity still slow, I checked back in with investors. Most said crypto VC continues to evolve and is becoming more like traditional venture capital.

Let's take a look.

*THE INSIDE VIEW*

*How the crypto VC market is changing*

Crypto venture dealmaking has slowed sharply in 2026. There have been just over 300 deals so far this year, compared with about 840 last year over the same period, a decline of nearly 64%, according to The Block's Data Dashboard. ( https://www.theblock.co/data/alternative-crypto-metrics/crypto-funding/monthly-venture-deals-count-by-category?utm_campaign=website&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=theblocknewsletters )

Funding dollars have held up much better, though. Over $8.1 billion has been invested so far this year, down roughly 13% from $9.4 billion over the same period in 2025. Large rounds for companies including Kalshi, Polymarket, Crypto.com and Digital Asset helped keep the total high even as overall activity slowed.

My colleague and research analyst Ivan Wu used a rough calculation to look at this change. He divided funding dollars by recorded deal count. This figure increased from about $11.1 million per deal in 2025 to $27.1 million this year. It is not an average round size, but it shows how more funding is going to established companies with product-market fit. Very early-stage companies still find it difficult to raise money.

Will deal activity remain low? All investors I spoke to said that 2021, a high point for deal activity, is not coming back, and most noted that crypto VC is becoming more disciplined and more like traditional VC, with a stronger focus on real users and revenue.

Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.
